headline: Buenos Aires City Inflation Accelerates to 1.9% in October
summary: Inflation in the City of Buenos Aires accelerated to 1.9% in October, driven by housing, food, and seasonal prices, bringing the year-to-date accumulation to 26.1%.
why: City-level inflation figures act as a leading indicator for national Consumer Price Index data released by INDEC, guiding monetary policy and fixed-income strategies.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation reduces purchasing power and signals persistent macroeconomic pressures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
